kernel: cub::DeviceRleSweepKernel (DeviceRunLengthEncode::NonTrivialRuns on int keys, one tile of 96 threads x 15 items = 1,440 items)

sites.source: tile_aggregate = ...warp_aggregates.Alias()[0]; and the loop tile_aggregate = scan_op(tile_aggregate, ...warp_aggregates.Alias()[WARP]);
sites.operation: ld.shared (SASS LDS.128 R24, [0x300] and LDS.128 R4, [0x310] at 0x1960/0x1970, attributed to agent_rle.cuh:461)

sites.source: items_shared[ranks[ITEM]] = input_items[ITEM];  (WarpExchange::ScatterToStriped, called from cub/cub/agent/agent_rle.cuh:496 in the time-sliced store path used by Policy860 on sm_89)
sites.operation: st.shared.v2.u32 / 64-bit (SASS STS.64 [Rn.X8], Rm at 0x2be0..0x2cd0, attributed to warp_exchange_smem.cuh:156)

thread_relation: cross-warp, same block (first tile, tile_idx == 0); intra-warp-0 lane pairs also race
thread_pair_example: block 0: a lane of warp 0 whose rank is 96..98 stores items_shared[rank] at byte 8*rank = 0x300..0x317, which aliases scan_storage.warp_aggregates (the SASS reads them at 0x300..0x31f); warp 1 or 2 (thread 32 or 64) reads warp_aggregates[1]/[2] at agent_rle.cuh:455/:461/:469. Needs >= 97 non-trivial run starts in warp 0's range: the driver (key = i/2) has 240.
class_reason: all accesses are plain shared loads/stores (no volatile, no atomics).
buggy_expected: a shared-memory WAR data race (DR) between the warp_aggregates reads and the exchange stores on the first tile, reported across warps (and between lanes of warp 0).

fixed.reason: the fix adds CTA_SYNC() at the end of WarpScanAllocations() (agent_rle.cuh +4 lines): the fixed SASS has a BAR.SYNC at 0x19b0 directly after the LDS of the warp aggregates (0x1990); in the buggy SASS no barrier separates the reads from the exchange stores (next BAR at 0x2570).

sass_notes: buggy: BAR.SYNC 0x1920, then LDS.128 x2 (0x1960/0x1970, agent_rle.cuh:461) and LDS (0x1990, :455), no barrier, MEMBAR.SC.CTA at 0x1bb0 (single_pass_scan_operators.cuh:119), ..., STS.64 x15 at 0x2be0 (warp_exchange_smem.cuh:156). Kernel _ZN3cub...DeviceRleSweepKernel... in the driver. The non-time-sliced scatter lines (agent_rle.cuh:564/569) are not compiled for sm_89 in this policy (verify.corrections).

open_questions: verify.thread_pair's byte offsets were a hand calculation; the SASS shows warp_aggregates at 0x300.. (LDS.128 [0x300]) which is consistent with ranks 96-98 of the 8-byte exchange items, but the detector is the oracle for which lane pairs it reports.
